BUILD_N_ACTION.AvailableFiltersTooltip: Conditions restrict the bonus. Without a blueprint all must pass; in a blueprint combine them with AND, OR and NOT.
BUILD_N_ACTION.BonusNotFound: That bonus could no longer be found.
BUILD_N_ACTION.ConfigurationCopyTooltip: Create a duplicate of this bonus
BUILD_N_ACTION.CurrentBonusesTooltip: The bonuses you have created that are currently stored on this Actor, Item, or ActiveEffect.
BUILD_N_ACTION.CurrentFiltersTooltip: The filters currently applied to the bonus, further narrowing down which rolls it should apply to. Each filter must be true for the bonus to apply.

blockers.hint: The status conditions that block an aura from being transferred, such as a paladin's aura that is only active while the paladin is neither dead nor unconscious.
blockers.label: Blocking Conditions

disposition.hint: Which targets should be affected by this aura, relative to the disposition of the origin token.
disposition.label: Valid Targets

enabled.hint: Configure whether and how the bonus acts as an aura.
enabled.label: Enable

range.hint: The range of the aura, measured in feet (put in '-1' for an unlimited range).
range.label: Range

light.hint: If checked, the aura will be restricted by anything that blocks light.
light.label: Enforce Light Restrictions

move.hint: If checked, the aura will be restricted by anything that blocks movement.
move.label: Enforce Move Restrictions

sight.hint: If checked, the aura will be restricted by anything that blocks vision.
sight.label: Enforce Sight Restrictions

sound.hint: If checked, the aura will be restricted by anything that blocks sound.
sound.label: Enforce Sound Restrictions

self.hint: Whether the aura should affect its owner regardless of any other targeting behavior.
self.label: Affect Self

template.hint: If the aura affects the area within a Measured Template instead of having a range (for items that are able to place a template).
template.label: Applies to Template

enabled.hint: Configure whether and how the bonus consumes a property. A bonus cannot be set to consume unless it is optional.
enabled.label: Enable

formula.hint: The formula by which the bonus scales at each step.
formula.label: Scaling Formula

scales.hint: Decide whether this bonus can consume more than the base amount of the consumed property and scale its bonus accordingly.
scales.label: Enable Scaling

value.label: Consumed Values
value.hint: The amount that will be consumed when opting into this bonus.
value.hintScale: The minimum and maximum amounts that can be consumed when opting into this bonus.
value.hintScaleSlot: The minimum and maximum sizes of a spell slot to opt into this bonus. If a spell slot greater than this maximum is consumed, it grants no additional benefit.
value.hintSlot: The minimum size of a spell slot required to opt into this bonus.

step.label: Step
step.hint: The delta, or step, of the choices when consuming.

description.hint: The text that accompanies this bonus. While not required, this is shown in tooltips as well as any hints for optional bonuses.
description.label: Description

enabled.hint: Toggle this bonus on or off. A bonus that is toggled off will be completely ignored.
enabled.label: Enabled

exclusive.hint: Toggle whether this bonus applies only to the item on which it is created. A bonus cannot be set to apply to one specific item only, unless created on said item, and applying to attack, damage, save DCs, or tool checks.
exclusive.label: Exclusive

img.hint: The image of this bonus to display where relevant.
img.label: Image

optional.hint: Toggle whether this bonus should be opted into when rolling. Note that this feature is not available for bonuses to save DCs.
optional.label: Optional

reminder.hint: Toggle whether this bonus simply serves as a reminder. To use this, it must not be granting any bonuses or dice modifications. This feature is also only available for rolls that have a configuration dialog.
reminder.label: Reminder

abilities.hint: Filter by the ability score being used for the roll. This filter will respect items that are set to use their Default ability score, such as spells set to use the Spellcasting ability, or weapons that are Finesse.
abilities.label: Ability Modifier

actorCreatureSizes.hint: Filter by the creature size of the actor, requiring that the actor making the roll is one of the chosen creature sizes.
actorCreatureSizes.label: Creature Sizes

actorCreatureTypes.hint: Filter by the type of creature the rolling actor must be one of (or have as a subtype), or the type of creature the rolling actor must not be one of. For example 'undead', 'fey', or 'construct'. To designate a creature type as a subtype, write as many as you like in the actor's Subtype field, separated by a '/'.
actorCreatureTypes.label: Actor Creature Types

actorLanguages.hint: Filter by the languages the actor can or cannot speak, read, or write. This will take into account if an actor can speak an entire group of languages such as Primordial rather than only the specific dialects.
actorLanguages.label: Spoken Languages

arbitraryComparisons.hint: Insert numbers, roll data properties, strings, or a combination of the three, that must be in a specific relationship for the bonus to apply. This comparison can evaluate substrings by using either of the inequalities. You can also use roll data from a targeted token's actor by prepending with '@target'.
arbitraryComparisons.label: Arbitrary Comparisons

attackModes.hint: Filter by the type of attack the item is performing, which decides the damage roll. For example, an unarmed strike, a two-handed weapon attack, or ranged spell attack.
attackModes.label: Attack Modes

baseArmors.hint: Filter by the type of armor the actor must be wearing or must not be wearing (including shields). For example if wanting the bonus to apply only when wearing Chain Mail or while unarmored. This filter can take into account armor categories such as 'Light Armor' as well.
baseArmors.label: Armor Types

baseTools.hint: Filter by the types of tools the item making the roll must be one of or none of. For example if wanting the bonus to apply only when using an Herbalism Kit, Thieves' Tools, or Cobbler's Tools.
baseTools.label: Tool Types

baseWeapons.hint: Filter by the types of weapons the item making the roll must be one of or none of. For example if wanting the bonus to apply only when using a Battleaxe, Shortbow, or Longsword. This filter can take categories into account as well.
baseWeapons.label: Weapon Types

creatureTypes.hint: Filter by the type of creature the targeted actor must be one of (or have as a subtype), or the type of creature the targeted actor must not be one of. For example 'undead', 'fey', or 'construct'. To designate a creature type as a subtype, write as many as you like in the actor's Subtype field, separated by a '/'.
creatureTypes.label: Target Creature Types

customScripts.hint: Filter using any custom script you want to write yourself. The script has to be completely synchronous and must explicitly return true or false. As helper variables, the script is supplied with the actor and token of the one performing the roll ('actor' and 'token'), the item being used ('item', if any), and the bonus on which this script is attached ('bonus'). These variables can be accessed directly.
customScripts.label: Custom Script

damageTypes.hint: Filter by the type of damage that must be or must not be part of the roll. For example if a spell must be dealing fire or lightning damage.
damageTypes.label: Damage Types

featureTypes.hint: Filter by the type and subtype a feature-type item must be. For example a class feature, ki feature, or monster feature.
featureTypes.label: Feature Types

healthPercentages.hint: Filter by the percentage of health the actor must at least have, or at most have. For example if the actor performing the roll must be at or above 90% health remaining.
healthPercentages.label: Health Percentage

identifiers.hint: Filter by the identifiers that an item must have one of for the bonus to apply. You can set an item's identifier in its source config.
identifiers.label: Identifiers

itemTypes.hint: Filter by the type of the item being used to perform the roll. For example if the bonus should only apply to spells or only to weapons.
itemTypes.label: Item Types

markers.label: Markers
markers.hint: Filter by markers that must be stored on actor performing the roll for the bonus to apply. The item being used, or its actor, must have at least one of these markers. Any markers stored on applied effects will also be valid. You can additionally compare for markers on your target.

target.label: Target Markers
target.hint: Markers of which one must be present on the target.

values.label: Markers
values.hint: Markers of which one must be present on the one performing the roll.

preparationModes.hint: Filter by the type of preparation mode a spell must be set to for the bonus to apply. For example when using a spell that is prepared as Pact Magic or Ritual Spellcasting.
preparationModes.label: Preparation Modes

proficiencyLevels.hint: Filter by the level of proficiency of the roll. For example, if the bonus should only apply if the tool being used is rolled with expertise, or if a saving throw is non-proficient.
proficiencyLevels.label: Proficiency Levels

remainingSpellSlots.hint: Filter by the minimum and maximum total number of spell slots the actor performing the roll must have remaining for the bonus to apply. For example if you want a bonus to apply only if you have 3 spell slots or more remaining, or no spell slots remaining at all. This can be toggled such that each remaining spell slot has a value equal to its size.
remainingSpellSlots.label: Remaining Spell Slots

size.label: Size
size.hint: Take the size of the spell slot into account, meaning a spell slot of 5th level counts as a value of five. Otherwise, each spell slots count as one.

saveAbilities.hint: Filter by the ability score that must be used to set the saving throw DC of the item for the bonus to apply; for example a Battle Master fighter who determines their Maneuver DC with Dexterity. This can be different from the ability the item otherwise uses. If an item is set to scale with 'Spellcasting', the spellcasting ability of the actor performing the roll is used to compared.
saveAbilities.label: Save DC Abilities

skillIds.hint: Filter by the types of skills the roll being performed must be one of or none of. For example if the bonus should apply only to skill checks made with Athletics, Nature, or Survival.
skillIds.label: Skills

sourceClasses.hint: Filter by the identifiers of the classes that a spell should belong to. A source class identifier can be set in the spell on the Details tab.
sourceClasses.label: Source Classes

spellComponents.hint: Filter by the components or tags the spell being cast must have. You can choose whether the spell must have all of the given components or tags, or at least one of them. For example if you want a bonus to apply to all spells that require concentration or all spells with a material component.
spellComponents.label: Spell Components

spellLevels.hint: Filter by the level at which the spell must be cast. For example, you can have a bonus apply only to cantrips, only to leveled spells, or only to spells of 3rd level or below.
spellLevels.label: Spell Levels

spellSchools.hint: Filter by the school a spell must belong to. If multiple schools are selected, the spell must belong to any one of them. For example, if you want a bonus to apply only to Divination or Evocation spells.
spellSchools.label: Spell Schools

statusEffects.hint: Filter by the conditions the actor performing the roll must be affected by or must not be affected by. This will take into account any condition immunities the actor has, such as immunity to being paralyzed.
statusEffects.label: Actor Conditions

targetArmors.hint: Filter by the type of armor the target must be wearing or must not be wearing (including shields). For example if wanting the bonus to apply only when the target is wearing Chain Mail or is unarmored. This filter can take into account armor categories such as 'Light Armor' as well.
targetArmors.label: Target Armor

targetEffects.hint: Filter by the conditions the targeted actor must be affected by or must not be affected by. This will take into account any condition immunities the actor has, such as immunity to being paralyzed.
targetEffects.label: Target Conditions

throwTypes.hint: Filter by the type of saving throw the bonus should apply to. For example if the bonus should apply only to Intelligence or Charisma saving throws, or even to Death saving throws or saving throws to maintain concentration on an effect.
throwTypes.label: Saving Throw Types

tokenSizes.hint: Filter by the size of a targeted token, and whether to compare against the rolling token as well. For example if it should be required that a targeted token is at least 2-by-2 but also larger than the token of the actor performing the roll.
tokenSizes.label: Token Sizes

self.label: Compare to self
self.hint: If checked, the target token must be larger/smaller than the rolling actor's token size in addition to the above value.

weaponProperties.hint: Filter by the weapon properties that the item being used to perform the roll either must have some of or cannot have any of. For example if the bonus should apply only to Two-Handed weapons or Versatile weapons.
weaponProperties.label: Weapon Properties

mode.hint: Whether to add the additional dice on top or multiply the value by this amount.
mode.label: Mode

value.hint: The increase to the amount of dice rolled.
value.label: Additional Dice

enabled.label: Enabled Modifications
enabled.hint: Toggle which dice modifications should be configurable and applying to the die rolls.

first.hint: If checked, the die modifiers only apply to the first die in the full expression.
first.label: First Die Only

limit.hint: The maximum amount of explosions allowed. If left blank, there will not be any limit enforced.
limit.label: Maximum Explosions

once.hint: Limit the dice to explode at most once.
once.label: Explode Once

value.hint: The threshold for the explosive behaviour.
value.label: Threshold

enabled.hint: Allow this bonus to configure the maximum result rolled on each die.
enabled.label: Maximum Results

value.hint: The maximum result able to be rolled. By using negative values, the ceiling will be calculated from the top rather than the bottom.
value.label: Maximum Value

zero.hint: Allow 0 as a final value. Otherwise the minimum result allowed will be 1.
zero.label: Allow Zero

enabled.hint: Allow this bonus to configure the minimum result rolled on each die.
enabled.label: Minimum Results

value.hint: The minimum result able to be rolled. By using negative values, the floor will be calculated from the top rather than the bottom.
value.label: Minimum Value

maximize.hint: Cause all dice to be maximized.
maximize.label: Maximize

enabled.hint: Allow this bonus to cause the dice to reroll.
enabled.label: Rerolling Behaviour

invert.hint: Whether to reroll dice that roll above the threshold instead of below the threshold.
invert.label: Inverted

limit.hint: The maximum amount of rerolls allowed if recursive. If left blank, there will not be any limit enforced.
limit.label: Maximum Rerolls

recursive.hint: Whether to reroll the dice recursively.
recursive.label: Recursive

value.hint: The threshold for the reroll behaviour.
value.label: Threshold

enabled.hint: Allow this bonus to make changes to the size of dice rolled.
enabled.label: Size Modification

mode.hint: Whether to increase the dice sizes by the amount or multiply the faces.
mode.label: Mode

value.hint: The increase to the size of the dice rolled.
value.label: Size Increase

BUILD_N_ACTION.OverviewCopied: The uuid has been copied to clipboard.
BUILD_N_ACTION.RegionConfigHint: Open the builder for bonuses on this scene region. These will apply to any token contained within the region.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SelectTypeTooltip: Select a type for your new bonus; the kind of roll to which it should apply.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsAllowFumbleNegationHint: Allow for modifiers to the fumble range on attack rolls to go below 1?
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsDisableCustomScriptFilterHint: Disable the 'Custom Script' filters from having their values read. Instead the filter always immediately returns true. Enable this setting if you prefer other users not executing scripts.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsDisplayLabelHint: If checked, the label is displayed in the header of applicable actors, items, and effects.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsPadAuraRadiusHint: On gridless scenes, extend the radius of auras due to token size?
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsShowAuraRangesHint: Create a visual indicator for the ranges of buildNAction auras. This does not apply to template auras or auras with unlimited ranges. If the roller is within an aura, it is marked green, otherwise red.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsShowBuilderForPlayersHint: If disabled, the icon to enter the builder will not be available in the header for players.
BUILD_N_ACTION.SettingsShowSheetTabHint: Add a new tab on the character/npc sheets rather than adding a header button.

field.label: Markers
field.hint: Apply markers to this document for the purpose of the 'Markers' filter.

bonus.label: Attack Roll Bonus
bonus.hint: Additional parts to add on top of the attack roll.

criticalRange.label: Critical Range Modifier
criticalRange.hint: An integer to subtract from the critical range of the attack roll. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.

fumbleRange.label: Fumble Range Modifier
fumbleRange.hint: An integer to add to the fumble range of the attack roll. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.

bonus.label: Damage Roll Bonus
bonus.hint: Additional parts to add on top of the damage roll.

criticalBonusDamage.hint: Additional parts to add on top of the damage roll on critical hits.
criticalBonusDamage.label: Extra Critical Hit Damage

criticalBonusDice.hint: An additional number of dice that should be rolled on a critical hit. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.
criticalBonusDice.label: Extra Critical Hit Dice

damageType.hint: The damage type of the parts added to the damage roll.
damageType.label: Damage Type

bonus.label: Hit Die Roll Bonus
bonus.hint: Additional parts to add on top of the hit die roll.
An integer to add onto the DC of a saving throw. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.
bonus.label: Save DC Bonus
Ability Check Bonus
bonus.hint: Additional parts to add on top of the ability check.
Additional parts to add on top of the saving throw roll.
bonus.label: Saving Throw Bonus

deathSaveCritical.hint: An integer to subtract from the threshold that decides when a Death Saving Throw results in restoring consciousness and 1 hit point. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.
deathSaveCritical.label: Death Save Critical Limit

targetValue.hint: An integer to subtract from the minimum requirement to pass a saving throw. This field respects roll data, but not dice rolls.
targetValue.label: Target Value

Blueprint.Title: Condition blueprints
Blueprint.Subtitle: Build, inspect and test your conditions
Blueprint.SelectNode: Select a node to edit its parameters and see an example.
Blueprint.ConnectHint: Connect: output dot → input dot · Drag background to pan · Scroll to zoom
Blueprint.orHint: At least one connected condition must pass.
Blueprint.notHint: Invert one condition: true becomes false.
Blueprint.CloseConfirm: Discard unsaved blueprint changes? The saved bonus will remain unchanged.
Blueprint.Valid: Structure and required parameters are valid.
Blueprint.Invalid: Fix the highlighted nodes before saving.
Blueprint.TrialHint: Choose the roll context. The trace explains which conditions pass, fail or cannot be evaluated.
Blueprint.TrialLimit: Checks conditions only. Does not apply damage, consume resources or verify aura range, bonus suppression or every possible game state. Custom scripts and formula comparisons are skipped.
Blueprint.ScriptSkipped: Scripts never execute in a trial.
Blueprint.FormulaSkipped: Formula comparisons may roll dice and are not executed in a trial.
Blueprint.MissingContext: Required actor, item, activity, target or roll details are missing.
Blueprint.EvaluationError: This condition could not be safely evaluated.
Blueprint.ResultHint: Applies this bonus when the incoming logic is true.
Blueprint.SharedFilterHint: Each condition type has one configuration. Repeated comparisons remain grouped inside that node.
Blueprint.PermissionDenied: You do not have permission to edit this bonus.
Blueprint.Conflict: This bonus changed after you opened the editor. Reopen it before saving to avoid overwriting those changes.
Blueprint.UnsupportedGraph: This saved graph has an unsupported format and cannot be overwritten here.
Blueprint.ActiveGraph: A blueprint controls this bonus. Open it to inspect connections after editing conditions.
Blueprint.EffectsHint: Show flames, sparks and other decorative node effects on this device. Changes apply immediately.
Blueprint.MotionHint: Animate transitions and interactions on this device. Reduced-motion preferences also disable motion.
Blueprint.branchHint: One input, two boolean outputs: Yes repeats the input; No inverts it. Unknown stays unknown on both. For example, connect an HP condition to split low/high health rules. Each output can feed several nodes. These are condition signals, not sequential actions.
Blueprint.xorHint: Two inputs A/B, one output. Passes when exactly one input passes. For example: fire OR cold, but not both.
Blueprint.nandHint: Two inputs A/B, one output. Fails only when both inputs pass. For example: disallow the bonus only when the actor is both blinded and frightened.
Blueprint.norHint: Two inputs A/B, one output. Passes only when both inputs fail. For example: the actor is neither poisoned nor frightened.
Blueprint.inCombatHint: Passes while the active combat encounter is started. Example: a bonus available in combat, but not during exploration. Does not test whose turn it is.
Blueprint.hasTargetHint: Passes when this roll has a target with an actor. Example: require a target before evaluating its armor. The trial uses the selected target.
Blueprint.hasItemHint: Passes when this roll uses an item. Example: skip a bonus for an ordinary ability check without an item.

Issues.Malformed: The graph has an invalid or unsupported structure.
Issues.UnknownFilter: This condition is not supported for this bonus.
Issues.MissingParameters: The condition has no configured value.
Issues.DuplicateFilter: Use one node per condition type.
Issues.OmittedFilter: A configured condition is missing from the graph. Add it from the library.
Issues.ResultCount: The graph needs exactly one result node.
Issues.DanglingEdge: A connection points to a missing node.
Issues.PortDirection: Connections must run from an output to an input.
Issues.Cycle: This connection creates a loop. Remove a connection to break it.
Issues.Disconnected: This node does not reach the result.
Issues.UnsupportedGraph: This saved graph has an unsupported format and cannot be overwritten here.
Issues.BinaryInputs: Connect exactly one source to each input A and B.

abilities.example: Select Strength: a Strength attack passes; a Dexterity attack does not.
abilities.context: Ability used by the activity or check.

actorCreatureSizes.example: Select Small: a Small actor passes; a Medium actor does not.

actorCreatureTypes.example: Select humanoid: a humanoid actor passes; an undead actor does not.

actorLanguages.example: Select Common: an actor who knows Common passes.

arbitraryComparisons.example: Compare @abilities.str.mod >= 3: a modifier of +4 passes. Every comparison in the node must pass.
arbitraryComparisons.context: Roll data, optionally @target; skipped during trial.

attackModes.example: Select melee and weapon: a melee weapon attack passes; a ranged spell attack does not.
attackModes.context: Attack activity's type, classification and mode.

baseArmors.example: Include heavy armor: an actor wearing heavy armor passes.
baseArmors.context: Equipped armor and shields of the rolling actor.

baseTools.example: Select thieves' tools: a check with those tools passes.

baseWeapons.example: Select longsword: a longsword passes; a shortbow does not.
baseWeapons.context: Base weapon of the used item.

creatureTypes.example: Select undead: an item belonging to an undead creature passes.
creatureTypes.context: The used item's actor; includes race identifiers where supported.

customScripts.example: return actor.system.attributes.hp.value > 0; checks whether the actor has HP. Trial never executes the script.
customScripts.context: Actor, item, token, bonus, activity and details provided to the script.

damageTypes.example: Include fire: an activity with a fire damage part passes. This condition does not add fire damage itself.
damageTypes.context: Damage or healing parts of the activity.

featureTypes.example: Select class feature: class features pass; racial features do not.
featureTypes.context: Feature item's type and optional subtype.

healthPercentages.example: Set 50% or lower: the rolling actor at 12/30 HP passes; at 20/30 HP does not. Exactly 50% passes.
healthPercentages.context: Rolling actor's HP percentage, excluding temporary HP.

identifiers.example: Enter fireball: an item with identifier fireball passes, regardless of its translated name.

itemTypes.example: Select spell: spells pass; weapons do not.

markers.example: Require a target marker called hunted: a target carrying that BnA marker passes.
markers.context: BnA markers on actor/item/effects and optional target.

preparationModes.example: Select prepared: prepared spell mode passes; innate mode does not.

proficiencyLevels.example: Select expertise: checks with double proficiency pass; normal proficiency does not.
proficiencyLevels.context: Proficiency multiplier for this specific roll.

remainingSpellSlots.example: Set minimum 1: at least one remaining slot is required. Enable weighting to count slot levels.
remainingSpellSlots.context: Remaining spell slots of the rolling actor.

saveAbilities.example: Select Wisdom: a save DC calculated from Wisdom passes.
saveAbilities.context: Ability used to calculate the save DC, not the target's saving throw ability.

skillIds.example: Include Stealth: Stealth checks pass; Perception checks do not.

sourceClasses.example: Select wizard: a spell associated with the wizard class passes.

spellComponents.example: Select verbal and somatic with ALL: the spell must have both components. ANY requires just one.

spellLevels.example: Select level 1: a first-level spell passes; a cantrip does not.

spellSchools.example: Include evocation: an evocation spell passes.

statusEffects.example: Include poisoned: a poisoned rolling actor passes. Exclude poisoned to require its absence.
statusEffects.context: Rolling actor's conditions, accounting for condition immunity.

targetArmors.example: Include heavy armor: a target wearing heavy armor passes.
targetArmors.context: Selected target's equipped armor and shields.

targetEffects.example: Include prone: a prone target passes; a standing target does not.

throwTypes.example: Select concentration: concentration saving throws pass; ordinary saves do not.
throwTypes.context: Saving throw ability or special type in roll details.

tokenSizes.example: Set at least 2: a target token 2 squares wide passes; a 1-square token does not.
tokenSizes.context: Target token dimensions on the scene; optionally compared to the rolling token.

weaponProperties.example: Include finesse: a weapon with the finesse property passes.
